column1: # EXPLORATORY, NOT THE RUN OF RECORD. Qwen3-32B's pinned serving line (section 6.1) is
# bf16 on one a100-80 and that pool is full of another campaign's jobs. This scores the
# frozen corpus on the free h200-141 instead, with BOTH Q1 prompts, all three (a, the file of record, plus revisions b and c), so the prompt question
# is answered before a scarce a100 is spent. Every vote and every report carries
# serving_line=exploratory-h200-141. bcf/judges_gate_a100.tsv is unchanged and is what
# runs when the a100-80 pool frees.
# BCF_ALL_JUDGE_ROWS=1 because the panel rule routes the Qwen judge away from a corpus

# wrote three empty reports in 1 second. The own-family votes are recorded as such and
# stay out of any panel label, which is what section 6.2's all-four subsample is for.
